payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used to assess the generated text, including WER, edit distance, and manual evaluations by journalists.

claims.text: The evaluation metrics include Word Error Rate (WER) and edit distance, which measure the number of insertions, substitutions, and deletions needed to correct the generated text.
Manual evaluations were conducted by journalists to assess the acceptability of the generated text for production use in a news agency.
The model was trained and validated using gold standard event selection to compare generated text against reference texts.
